## Change

What does this add or improve? Name the district, landmark or system, and describe what players will notice.

## Try it

Include the local launch URL or start location, the relevant weather or time, and the shortest steps to see the change.

## Evidence

Record the checks you ran and their results. Include a screenshot or clip when it shows a visible change. List any paths, systems or conditions you could not verify.

## Asset sources

List new or revised assets, their sources and redistribution terms. Write “None” if there are no asset changes.

## Review scope

Choose standard or maintainer review using the [city rulebook](https://github.com/HareliField/OpenCity/blob/main/asphalt-heat/README.md#city-rulebook). Call out any shared systems, street geometry, or release changes and how to undo them.

- [ ] I tried the local preview or reviewed its evidence and approved submitting this change.
